title: Live Training Quiz
description: Schema for quiz.json (QUIZ_PATH). Matches validateQuiz in src/quiz.ts. Catalog membership (domains↔domain, use_cases↔use-case) is enforced at load when catalog arrays are present.

title.description: Non-empty quiz title (whitespace-only rejected at load).

metadata.description: Optional authoring bag and value catalogs for question metadata. Omitted or null → absent at load. Not part of quiz fingerprint. When domains/use_cases arrays are present, paired question fields must use a catalog member (runtime).

domains.description: Allowed values for question metadata.domain (exact string match).

use_cases.description: Allowed values for question metadata.use-case (exact string match).

credential.description: Optional credential or exam name (authoring only).

config.description: Optional quiz presentation/config. Omitted or null → absent at load. Not part of quiz fingerprint. Runtime retains known fields only (slideMetadataKeys).

slideMetadataKeys.description: Ordered question.metadata keys to show on projector slides. Duplicates rejected at load. Missing values on a question are skipped at render.

text.description: Non-empty question prompt. Markdown is supported.

choices.description: Answer options; at least two non-empty strings.

correct.description: 0-based index into choices; must be < choices.length (enforced at load).

explain.description: Optional explanation after reveal. Omitted or null → empty string at load. Markdown is supported.

metadata.description: Optional authoring bag per question (domain, use-case, live, tags, …). Arbitrary nested JSON values allowed. Omitted or null → absent at load. Used by startup filters and slide display; not part of quiz fingerprint.
